questions.prompt: Medical term for a heart attack?
questions.feedbackCorrect: Yes: death of heart muscle from blocked blood flow.
questions.feedbackIncorrect: A heart attack is a myocardial infarction: blocked blood flow kills heart muscle.

questions.prompt: Medical term for high blood pressure?
questions.feedbackCorrect: Right: hypertension is persistently elevated blood pressure.
questions.feedbackIncorrect: High blood pressure is called hypertension.

questions.prompt: Chamber that pumps blood to the body?
questions.feedbackCorrect: Right: the left ventricle pumps oxygenated blood to the body.
questions.feedbackIncorrect: The left ventricle, not the right, pumps blood to the body.

questions.feedbackCorrect: Right: vision is processed in the occipital lobe.
questions.feedbackIncorrect: Vision is processed at the back of the brain, in the occipital lobe.

questions.prompt: Structure joining the two cerebral hemispheres?
questions.feedbackCorrect: Right: the corpus callosum connects the two hemispheres.
questions.feedbackIncorrect: The corpus callosum is the band of fibers joining the hemispheres.

questions.feedbackCorrect: Right: cranial nerve I, the olfactory nerve, carries smell.
questions.feedbackIncorrect: Smell travels through the olfactory nerve (cranial nerve I).

questions.prompt: Blood leaves the heart to the body through the ___.
questions.feedbackCorrect: Right: the aorta carries blood from the heart to the body.
questions.feedbackIncorrect: Blood leaves the left ventricle through the aorta.

questions.prompt: The ___ ventricle pumps blood to the ___.
questions.feedbackCorrect: Right: the left ventricle pumps to the body (systemic circulation).
questions.feedbackIncorrect: The left ventricle pumps blood to the body, through the aorta.
